SPN - Malawi - Project Procurement Specialist - Rehabilitation of Kapichira I Project
22-Apr-2026
The Government of Malawi, through the Electricity Generation Company (Malawi) Limited (EGENCO), is implementing the Rehabilitation and Modernization Works of the Kapichira 1 Hydropower Plant Project. The project, supported by the African Development Bank (AfDB), aims at enhancing the operational efficiency, reliability, and capacity of the Kapichira Hydro Power Plant.
The project involves rehabilitation and modernization efforts including repair works, upgrading equipment, and improving overall plant performance to meet demand. The project will contribute significantly to the country’s sustainable energy goals, ensuring a stable power supply and enhancing socio-economic development.
